eligibility.pageIntro: We compare what you told us with the published rules for this opportunity.
eligibility.rechecking: Checking again with your new answer…

ELIGIBLE.title: You meet the rules we could check
ELIGIBLE.body: Every rule we could check says you can apply. This is not a promise that you will get it. The provider decides.

INELIGIBLE.title: You do not meet at least one rule
INELIGIBLE.body: Based on what you told us, at least one published rule is not met. See below which one.

UNKNOWN.title: We cannot tell yet
UNKNOWN.body: Nothing says you cannot apply, but we are missing information. Not knowing is not a "no".

NEEDS_REVIEW.title: A person needs to check this
NEEDS_REVIEW.body: We could not settle this by ourselves. Please ask your teacher or the provider, and read the official page.

reason.education_stage_not_met: Your class or course is not one of those listed.
reason.age_below_minimum: You are younger than the minimum age.
reason.age_above_maximum: You are older than the maximum age.
reason.family_income_above_limit: Your family income is above the limit.
reason.conflicting_state: You gave us different answers about your state.
reason.conflicting_education_stage: You gave us different answers about your class or course.
reason.conflicting_annual_family_income_inr: You gave us different answers about your family income.
reason.conflicting_date_of_birth: We hold different dates of birth for you.
reason.missing_state: We do not know your state.
reason.missing_education_stage: We do not know your class or course.
reason.missing_annual_family_income_inr: We do not know your family income.
reason.missing_date_of_birth: We do not know your date of birth.
reason.criteria_not_verified: The rules for who can apply have not been verified.
reason.no_verified_criteria: We hold no verified rules for who can apply.
reason.other_criteria_need_review: The official page lists other rules that a person must check.
reason.record_stale: This record was last checked a long time ago.

basis.observed: a teacher or helper saw this

eligibility.missingTitle: What we still need to know
eligibility.missingIntro: You can answer here and we will check again.
eligibility.noQuestion: We could not find the question for this. Please try the interview page.
eligibility.setAtRegistration: This was given when you registered. It cannot be changed here.
eligibility.separate: Eligibility is separate from whether this suits you. Meeting the rules does not mean it is a good choice for you, and not meeting them does not mean you are not capable.
eligibility.officialLink: Go to the official website (this leaves Ruralpulse)
